stories.title: "Nunca lo hemos solicitado"; Tatiana Clouthier responde a negativa del PT de dar apoyo a su posible candidatura en Nuevo León

en.title: "We have never requested it"; Tatiana Clouthier responds to PT's refusal to support her possible candidacy in Nuevo León
en.summary: The former Economy Secretary addressed the Labor Party's decision not to back her potential candidacy in Nuevo León, clarifying that she had not sought their support.

stories.title: ¿Qué sabemos sobre la muerte de una trabajadora del laboratorio del Instituto de la Peste en Rusia?

en.title: What do we know about the death of a laboratory worker at Russia's Plague Institute?
en.summary: A laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia became ill and died on October 2 under undisclosed circumstances, leading authorities to quarantine approximately 200 people and sparking public health concerns on social media.

stories.title: Nobel de Física a Francis Halzen es "merecidísimo" y en un campo que está de moda, según expertos

en.title: Physics Nobel Prize for Francis Halzen is "well-deserved" and in a field that is trending, according to experts
en.summary: Experts affirmed that Halzen's determined, charismatic, and enthusiastic approach enabled him to launch the IceCube experiment, earning recognition in a currently popular scientific field.

stories.title: Mexicanos recortan gastos en comida y salud para mantener su vivienda

en.title: Mexicans cut spending on food and health to maintain their housing
en.summary: Eight out of ten surveyed individuals reduced at least one expense over the past year to cover housing costs, with 36 percent using savings and 34 percent taking additional work.

stories.title: Patrulla Fronteriza derriba árbol de 250 años para avanzar con muro entre Sonora y Arizona; Nación Tohono O’odham denuncia desalojo de defensores

en.title: Border Patrol fells 250-year-old tree to advance wall between Sonora and Arizona; Tohono O'odham Nation denounces removal of defenders
en.summary: U.S. Border Patrol cut down an ancient Cottonwood tree during wall construction work. An indigenous community reported that armed agents forcibly removed environmental activists who had camped for over a month to protect the tree.

stories.title: Paramount cierra la fusión con Warner Bros para crear Skydance, un gigante de Hollywood

en.title: Paramount closes merger with Warner Bros to create Skydance, a Hollywood giant
en.summary: Paramount and Warner Bros completed their merger to form Skydance after obtaining necessary regulatory approvals from U.S. states and resolving labor disputes with Hollywood writers.

stories.title: OMS pide a Rusia información sobre posible caso mortal de peste neumónica en Siberia; aún ve "muy bajo" el riesgo sanitario

en.title: WHO requests information from Russia on possible fatal pneumonic plague case in Siberia; still sees "very low" health risk
en.summary: The World Health Organization asked Russia for details regarding a potential fatal pneumonic plague case in Siberia while assessing the overall health risk as very low.

stories.title: Harfuch anuncia captura de "El Tanque", líder del CJNG en Veracruz, Oaxaca, Tabasco y Puebla

en.title: Harfuch announces capture of "El Tanque," CJNG leader in Veracruz, Oaxaca, Tabasco and Puebla
en.summary: Mexico's Security Secretary reported the detention of a suspected regional leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel in Jalisco state. The arrested individual was identified as Iván "N", known as "El Tanque."

stories.title: Rusia niega haber ordenado restricciones por un supuesto caso de peste neumónica

en.title: Russia denies ordering restrictions over alleged pneumonic plague case
en.summary: Russian authorities denied imposing health restrictions in the Siberian region of Irkutsk following the death of an employee at a plague research institute.

stories.title: Cierra Paramount la fusión con Warner Bros. Discovery

en.title: Paramount closes merger with Warner Bros. Discovery
en.summary: Paramount Skydance completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery for 110 billion dollars, concluding one of the largest media mergers in history.

stories.title: Cae 'El Tanque', líder regional del CJNG y cercano al Mencho

en.title: El Tanque, regional leader of CJNG and close to Mencho, arrested
en.summary: Authorities announced the capture of El Tanque, a regional CJNG leader operating in Veracruz, Oaxaca, Tabasco and Puebla with ties to El Mencho.

stories.title: La OMS ve riesgo "muy bajo" para Europa tras sospecha de peste en Rusia

en.title: WHO sees "very low" risk for Europe following plague suspicion in Russia
en.summary: The suspected death of a 28-year-old woman from pneumonic plague in Russia's Irkutsk region raised concerns, prompting a risk assessment from the World Health Organization.

stories.title: Banco de México destaca respaldo del FMI y descarta alarma por depreciación del peso

en.title: Bank of Mexico highlights IMF support and rules out concern over peso depreciation
en.summary: Mexico's central bank deputy governor emphasized confidence from multilateral institutions, though the IMF projects slower inflation convergence toward the 3% target through 2028.

stories.title: El registro telefónico supera los 90 millones de líneas vinculadas

en.title: Telephone registry exceeds 90 million linked lines
en.summary: Mexico's telephone registry has surpassed 90 million registered lines following the deadline for phone numbers ending in 3.

stories.title: Convocatoria UNAM: fechas, costo del examen y requisitos para ingresar a licenciatura

en.title: UNAM call for applications: dates, exam cost and requirements to enter undergraduate programs
en.summary: Mexico's National University opened enrollment for distance learning undergraduate degrees, with registration starting October 8 and exams scheduled for November.

stories.title: Querétaro, Cancún y Los Cabos crecen, pero falta vivienda para sus trabajadores

en.title: Querétaro, Cancún and Los Cabos grow, but lack housing for their workers
en.summary: Employment is expanding in industrial and tourism centers in these three Mexican cities, yet affordable housing supply remains insufficient for arriving workers.

stories.title: Ganar el Nobel deja una fortuna: cuánto reciben y qué han hecho los ganadores con el dinero

en.title: Winning the Nobel brings a fortune: how much recipients receive and what winners have done with the money
en.summary: Nobel Prize winners receive a monetary award that can be shared, which laureates have used for various purposes including home purchases, retirement, scholarships and charitable donations.
